# 2 Timothy

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

2 Timothy encourages believers to remain faithful to God's Word, endure hardship, and finish their race with perseverance.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">2 Timothy 1:7</div>

<div class="identifier">God hath not given us the spirit of fear</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most quoted encouragement verses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter encourages Timothy to remain faithful and courageous in ministry. The key verse emphasizes that God gives believers power, love, and self-discipline rather than fear.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">2 Timothy 2:15</div>

<div class="identifier">Study to shew thyself approved unto God</div>

### Why This Verse

Foundational verse on handling Scripture

### Chapter Insight

This chapter calls for endurance, diligence, and faithful teaching. The key verse encourages believers to present themselves as approved workers who correctly handle God's Word.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">2 Timothy 3:16</div>

<div class="identifier">All Scripture is given by inspiration of God</div>

### Why This Verse

Key doctrine of Scripture

### Chapter Insight

This chapter warns of difficult times and emphasizes the authority of Scripture. The key verse teaches that all Scripture is inspired by God and equips believers for every good work.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">2 Timothy 4:7</div>

<div class="identifier">I have fought a good fight</div>

### Why This Verse

Paul's famous farewell

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains Paul's final charge and personal testimony. The key verse highlights finishing the race faithfully and anticipating God's eternal reward.
:::
